title: galactia obcordata
intro: Galactia obcordata, commonly known as the heart-shaped milk pea or heart pea, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). It is a climbing vine native to the southeastern United States. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Galactia obcordata contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
